about: I've spent 9+ years making sure software works before users find out it doesn't, from e-commerce sites to mainframe migrations to GenAI pipelines. Lately my focus is the hardest version of that problem: testing systems whose answers aren't fixed. I believe a good test suite is a product in its own right: fast, trusted and easy for the next engineer to extend.
